# Gifting API

Send branded merchandise programmatically. Integrate gifting into your CRM, sales workflows, or any application with a simple REST API.

## Quick Start

Three steps to send your first gift programmatically.

### Get your API key

Go to Dashboard → Integrations and create an API key. Available on the Stockroom subscription and Business plans.

### Add designs to a collection

Group the produced designs you want to ship into a collection. The API sends from any design with stock in your warehouse.

### Create a send

POST to /api/v2/sends with recipient address and design IDs. We handle fulfillment and shipping.

## Authentication

All API requests require a valid API key passed in the `X-API-Key` header. Keys are scoped to your company and available on the Stockroom subscription and Business plans.

```
curl "https://api.brandmerch.com/api/v1/sends/inventory?collectionId=col_welcome_kits" \
  -H "X-API-Key: bm_live_your_key_here"
```

SHA-256 hashed

Keys are stored as irreversible hashes

Company-scoped

Each key is tied to one company account

Revocable instantly

Revoke any key from the dashboard immediately

## Base URL

`https://api.brandmerch.com`

## API Endpoints

Click any endpoint to expand the full documentation.

POST`/api/v1/sends` Create a send

GET`/api/v1/sends/inventory` Check inventory by collection or design IDs

GET`/api/v1/sends/:id` Get send status & tracking

# How to automate client onboarding gifts with your CRM (2026)

How to automate client onboarding gifts: connect your CRM, choose a trigger like customer onboarded, fire a branded box automatically, collect addresses with a redeem link, and ship globally with zero hassle.

Niels Vandecasteele

·June 13, 2026·7 min read

TL;DR

To automate client onboarding gifts, connect your CRM, pick a trigger like customer onboarded, and send a redeem link so recipients confirm address and size. The platform warehouses stock and ships globally, so every new client gets the same welcome automatically.

Key takeaways

- Automate gifting because remembering a box for every new account is no one's core job, and automation removes inconsistency.
- Connect your CRM (e.g. HubSpot) and trigger on a real start signal like customer onboarded or license purchased.
- Fire the gift a few days to a week after signing, not at signature, to reactivate excitement during onboarding.
- Set a budget rule per deal size and stay generally under 50 euros so the gift reads as gratitude, not influence.
- Use a redeem link so recipients confirm address and size instead of shipping to stale CRM data.
- Keep it personal with a handwritten note while the platform handles timing, addresses and global shipping.
